name: Stanley Druckenmiller
style: Top down macro trader: finds the big trend, bets hard when the odds look best, and cuts fast when wrong.
why_follow: He has one of the best long records in macro, and his stock picks often lead big themes. Caveat: he trades fast, so a 13F that is six weeks old may already be stale, and his currency, bond and commodity bets do not show up. Several weights below include call options.

bought.name: Amazon
bought.note: Stake up more than tenfold to 541,600 shares, and call options more than doubled.

bought.name: Alphabet
bought.note: Reported as a new stake of about $120 million. One tracker disagrees, so treat as unconfirmed.

bought.name: Taiwan Semiconductor
bought.note: Stake up about 19% to about 590,000 shares, about $282 million.

bought.name: STMicroelectronics
bought.note: Added 490,000 shares to about 3.1 million, about $232 million.

view: In a Morgan Stanley interview released Feb 28, 2026, he said he likes the US economy and US stocks but is short the dollar, long copper and gold, short Treasuries, and leaning into biotech.
